# Repository file tree

This index links every maintained project file and summarizes its purpose.
Generated and runtime files are indexed in the collapsed appendix below. Only `.git/` internals and individual `node_modules/` contents are excluded; the installed dependency directory itself is linked.

## Repository root

- [`.gitignore`](.gitignore) - Excludes generated, secret, cache, build, and runtime files from Git.
- [`FILES_TREE.md`](FILES_TREE.md) - This complete maintained-file index.
- [`README.md`](README.md) - Project overview, quick start, server operation, and principal examples.
- [`pyproject.toml`](pyproject.toml) - Python package metadata, dependencies, console entry points, and pytest settings.
- [`requirements.txt`](requirements.txt) - Runtime Python dependency list.
- [`requirements-dev.txt`](requirements-dev.txt) - Development and test dependency list.
- [`mailbox-client`](mailbox-client) - Canonical POSIX mailbox-client launcher.
- [`mailbox-client.cmd`](mailbox-client.cmd) - Canonical Windows mailbox-client launcher.
- [`mailbox-server`](mailbox-server) - Canonical POSIX relay-server launcher.
- [`mailbox-server.cmd`](mailbox-server.cmd) - Canonical Windows relay-server launcher.
- [`mailbox-console`](mailbox-console) - Canonical POSIX interactive console launcher.
- [`mailbox-console.cmd`](mailbox-console.cmd) - Canonical Windows interactive console launcher.
- [`whatsapp-personal-relay`](whatsapp-personal-relay) - POSIX launcher for the unofficial personal-WhatsApp companion.
- [`whatsapp-personal-relay.cmd`](whatsapp-personal-relay.cmd) - Windows launcher for the personal-WhatsApp companion.

## Configuration

- [`config/.env.example`](config/.env.example) - Non-secret template listing supported environment settings and credentials.
- [`config/mailboxes.json`](config/mailboxes.json) - Named mailbox transport and location profiles.
- [`config/relays.json`](config/relays.json) - Durable listeners, routes, qualified channels, and saved subscriptions.

## Documentation

- [`docs/INSTRUCTIONS.md`](docs/INSTRUCTIONS.md) - Comprehensive configuration, platform setup, addressing, CLI, REST, and integration guide.

## Personal WhatsApp companion

- [`companions/whatsapp-personal/package.json`](companions/whatsapp-personal/package.json) - Companion metadata, start script, and JavaScript dependencies.
- [`companions/whatsapp-personal/package-lock.json`](companions/whatsapp-personal/package-lock.json) - Locked dependency graph for reproducible companion installs.
- [`companions/whatsapp-personal/server.js`](companions/whatsapp-personal/server.js) - Local `whatsapp-web.js` linked-device service and signed relay callback implementation.

## Python package

- [`src/mailbox_channels/__init__.py`](src/mailbox_channels/__init__.py) - Package marker and package-level metadata.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/agent_mailbox.py`](src/mailbox_channels/agent_mailbox.py) - Standalone-capable mailbox-client implementation for JSONL and REST transports.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/server.py`](src/mailbox_channels/server.py) - HTTP/WebSocket server, REST API, webhook endpoints, status pages, and relay supervisor.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/channel_relay.py`](src/mailbox_channels/channel_relay.py) - Adapter orchestration, outbound dispatch, status events, retries, and channel fan-out.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/channel_routes.py`](src/mailbox_channels/channel_routes.py) - Runtime dispatch of configured channel-to-channel routes.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/listener_registry.py`](src/mailbox_channels/listener_registry.py) - Loading, expansion, validation, and safe publication of listener/route configuration.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/subscriptions.py`](src/mailbox_channels/subscriptions.py) - Durable qualified-address subscriptions and atomic subscriber updates.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/channel_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/channel_admin.py) - Unified local and external platform channel creation.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/chat_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/chat_admin.py) - Platform-neutral chat command parsing, address inference, and adapter dispatch.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/admin_io.py`](src/mailbox_channels/admin_io.py) - Shared `--input`, `--input-format`, and output formatting for platform commands.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/) - External chat-platform transport implementations.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/endpoint_address.py`](src/mailbox_channels/endpoint_address.py) - Parsing and canonicalization of `TYPE/INSTANCE/SOURCE_OR_DESTINATION` addresses.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/delivery_ledger.py`](src/mailbox_channels/delivery_ledger.py) - SQLite origin/endpoint traversal ledger for durable loop and duplicate suppression.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/identifier_directory.py`](src/mailbox_channels/identifier_directory.py) - Persistent system-scoped UUID, contact, name, and resolution-request directory.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/registry_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/registry_admin.py) - CLI management for UUID/identifier mappings and resolution requests.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/discovery_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/discovery_admin.py) - Platform resource discovery, beginning with native IRC channel listing.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/attachment_storage.py`](src/mailbox_channels/attachment_storage.py) - Managed attachment writes and per-file/aggregate storage quota enforcement.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/attachment_gateway.py`](src/mailbox_channels/attachment_gateway.py) - Safe public attachment URL generation and path-boundary enforcement.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/sqlite_limits.py`](src/mailbox_channels/sqlite_limits.py) - SQLite size-limit configuration shared by durable databases.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/websocket_chat.py`](src/mailbox_channels/websocket_chat.py) - WebSocket framing, session handling, message receive/send, and ping support.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/console_client.py`](src/mailbox_channels/console_client.py) - Trusted Speaker interactive WebSocket or local-JSONL client.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/token_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/token_admin.py) - Secure relay-token generation, registration, rotation, and status inspection.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/contact_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/contact_admin.py) - Contact import/list CLI backed by the identifier directory.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/route_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/route_admin.py) - Local and REST route list/attach/detach CLI.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/runtime_admin.py`](src/mailbox_channels/runtime_admin.py) - Trusted in-chat `!relay` route-management command handling.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/meta_webhooks.py`](src/mailbox_channels/meta_webhooks.py) - Shared Meta webhook verification and signature checking.

### Platform adapters

- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/mattermost_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/mattermost_adapter.py) - Complete Mattermost transport, discovery, command mapping, registry resolution, membership, files, threads, and REST behavior.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/discord_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/discord_adapter.py) - Discord channel polling and outbound message/file delivery.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/slack_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/slack_adapter.py) - Slack Web API polling, threaded messages, files, and multiple listener presences.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/matrix_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/matrix_adapter.py) - Matrix Client-Server sync, room messages, threads, and media transfer.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/irc_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/irc_adapter.py) - Complete IRC/TLS transport, discovery, protocol commands, joins, messages, and attachment-link delivery.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/telegram_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/telegram_adapter.py) - Telegram Bot API polling, topics, chat-name resolution, text, and documents.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/whatsapp_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/whatsapp_adapter.py) - WhatsApp Business Cloud API webhooks, direct/group delivery, and media handling.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/whatsapp_personal_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/whatsapp_personal_adapter.py) - Signed integration with the local personal-WhatsApp companion.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/facebook_messenger_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/facebook_messenger_adapter.py) - Facebook Page Messenger webhooks, PSID resolution, text, and attachments.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/viber_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/viber_adapter.py) - Viber Bot API signed callbacks, user resolution, messages, and public file links.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/line_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/line_adapter.py) - LINE signed webhooks, user/group/room conversations, media downloads, and pushes.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/adapters/discourse_adapter.py`](src/mailbox_channels/adapters/discourse_adapter.py) - Discourse signed post webhooks, topic creation, and replies.

### Served resources

- [`src/mailbox_channels/resources/INSTALL_WITH_CODEX.md`](src/mailbox_channels/resources/INSTALL_WITH_CODEX.md) - Prompt for installing the standalone mailbox client into another Codex workspace.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/resources/AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md`](src/mailbox_channels/resources/AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md) - Customizable recurring Codex mailbox-monitor prompt and manual verification instructions.
- [`src/mailbox_channels/resources/special_websocket_client.html`](src/mailbox_channels/resources/special_websocket_client.html) - Browser demonstration and links to live relay resources.

- [`tests/test_server_supervisor.py`](tests/test_server_supervisor.py) - Server options, runtime paths, retry recovery, and verbosity tests.
- [`tests/test_slack_adapter.py`](tests/test_slack_adapter.py) - Slack polling, multiple presences, files, threads, and outbound tests.
- [`tests/test_sqlite_limits.py`](tests/test_sqlite_limits.py) - SQLite maximum-size enforcement tests.
- [`tests/test_telegram_adapter.py`](tests/test_telegram_adapter.py) - Telegram updates, topics, identifiers, files, and outbound tests.
